name: SystemArchitecture
focus: High-level Blueberry protocol component and flow overview: users and integrations enter through bank/spell and vault interfaces; spells coordinate leveraged position actions through wrappers and money-market contracts; wrappers custody and tokenize external LP or gauge positions; oracle modules price assets using configured feeds and pool metadata; ProtocolConfig and fee management supply shared parameters. Show module contracts, key interface boundaries, external protocols/tokens/oracles, and control and asset flow between them.
